name: @workspace/mcp-server
description: Telling Forward MCP server. Exposes capsule-schema, canon-read, and draft-capsule-write tools to a user's own MCP host (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or another MCP-capable client), so the user's own AI subscription or local model does the ingestion reasoning. This package never calls an AI provider itself and holds no AI credentials — it only talks to GitHub, using a token the user supplies.
